facts: Report period: June to September (the last 4 complete months).
Total revenue for the period: $77.3K. Net profit: $4.0K. Profit margin: 5.2%.
Revenue by month: June $20.2K, July $18.6K, August $17.9K, September $20.5K.
Net profit by month: June $1.7K, July $1.0K, August $1.2K, September $0.2K.
Best month for sales: September at $20.5K, up 14% on August.
Average clean value: $181 across 427 cleans. Quotes won: 43%.
Biggest service type: Regular / Recurring Clean, $31.0K revenue, margin after overheads -2%, labour takes 73c of every dollar.
Strongest service type: Carpet / Window / Deep Clean, margin after overheads 23% (keeps 23c of every dollar).
Cleans cost 13% more than quoted: $6.7K over quote in total, 287 of 427 cleans over budget.
Revenue per paid hour: $54 against a target of $57. 81% of paid time is spent cleaning. Labour is 66% of revenue.
Average monthly sales: $19.3K. Break-even: $18.0K a month. A 7% drop in sales would mean a loss.
